lina: FYI — MeridianBridge wants a POC this month but they need a custom model variant onboarded to our catalog. Legal + security flagged some questions; pricing needs a clearer estimate. Can we triage?

yoav: What do they want exactly? model weights, format, quant, kv-cache usage, seq len, targets (rps/latency)?

lina: Model is a fork of Llama-family, ~33B. They want q4/QLoRA weights, uses persistent KV cache (sparse prefixes), typical seq len 2048 but can spike to 4096 in some flows. Target for demo: 200 reqs/min, p95 latency < 400ms.

yoav: ok — main compatibility risks: QLoRA adapters + q4 quant path, KV cache interaction with continuous batching, and longer seq support. I can run our compatibility checks and a tiny throughput test on dev infra.

yoav: Run this to start a preflight scan:
```
rw-infer scan --model s3://meridian/models/meridian-33b-qlora.tar --checks kv-cache,quant,seqlen --out report.json
```

deploy-bot: preflight-scan queued for 4278901234, est runtime ~12m — I'll post results when done.

carl: security flags: data residency (they process EU PHI), KMS/HSM integration required for keys, must support no-logging mode for KV traces, audit logs for inference requests, and SOC2 / ISO attestation copy. Any telemetry we collect must be opt-in.

lina: they explicitly asked for Private (VPC) option or Dedicated with tenant isolation. Legal also sent a 10-page security questionnaire — attaching in case legal-bot can auto-fill some parts.

legal-bot: security-questionnaire link: https://redwood.s3/legal/meridian-sq-2026-03.pdf (uploaded). Start: encryption at rest, key management, data deletion SLA 30d, subprocessors list.

tess: From product side — we can create a temporary catalog variant (meridian-33b-qlora-priv-v1) and schedule a canary rollout to Dedicated pool. Need model metadata (vocab, arch, ops per token) + a test prompt set for quality checks. Naming convention will include source+quant+date.

yoav: Pricing guidance for POC: hosted inference (burst) will be ~3-5x unit cost vs our standard due to q4 inefficiencies and KV overhead. Dedicated reserved POC node estimate: ~$8k-$12k/month for the minimal GPU setup for their throughput for the POC week (prorated). Recommend reserved hours for demo to avoid cold capacity spikes.

lina: Timeline — customer demo next Wed. We need compatibility report + security answers + pricing by EOD Fri to prepare slides.

yoav: I'll run scans today and put infra logs + perf numbers in the report.

tess: I'll create a draft catalog entry and a canary plan (A/B shadow route) and share the JSON metadata. Also will add a note about rollback -> fallback to base-33b if quality/regressions.

carl: blocker: license check on their fork — it includes some 3rd-party components. If any dependency is GPL-like we need legal signoff before hosting.

lina: ok noted. Assigning: yoav -> compatibility + perf report; tess -> catalog + rollout plan; carl -> security questionnaire answers + license check; legal-bot -> track legal signoff. Need updates in this thread by tomorrow noon. :thumbsup:
